sections.executive_summary: Iran held mass funerals for 350 unidentified battle casualties with the president and IRGC commander attending, signaling major undisclosed losses. Iran claimed responsibility for attacking a US early-warning radar in Bahrain, citing retaliation for an airstrike on a communications tower in Sirik, Iran. The IDF reported killing over 10 terror operatives in Gaza over the past week, including October 7 participants, and destroying a Hamas weapons production site.

points: Nationwide funerals were held for 350 unidentified 'battle casualties' across Iran, with the central ceremony at Tehran University for 110 bodies attended by the Iranian president and IRGC commander General Vahidi, indicating significant unreported military losses. (Source: @yediotnews25/137780)
A missile launcher was observed on the road from Baharestan to Mohammadabad in Isfahan Province, suggesting active missile deployment or movement in central Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/12342)

UAV activity was detected over Piranshahr in West Azerbaijan Province at 20:48 local time, and over the Fifth Base in Omidiyeh, Khuzestan Province at 1727Z, indicating persistent drone operations near western and southwestern borders. (Source: @shin_persian/12337, @shin_persian/12339)

Secondhand information reports a large number of missiles launched in western Iran around 1400Z, while a single ballistic missile was confirmed launched from Urmia, West Azerbaijan Province at 19:07 local time. (Source: @shin_persian/12334, @shin_persian/12335)

Hormozgan Governor's office stated no impacts or explosions occurred in Jask as of 22:25 local time, amid heightened alert. A jet departed Doran Air Base at 21:00 local heading south, possibly related to air defense or patrol missions. (Source: @shin_persian/12340, @shin_persian/12341)

The IAEA confidential report expresses growing concern over Iran preventing inspector access to an underground uranium enrichment facility in Isfahan since June 2025, noting the exact location and status are unclear, raising serious nuclear proliferation concerns. (Source: @yediotnews25/137790)
Israeli warplanes were observed over southern Lebanon, indicating ongoing aerial presence and potential strike operations in the area. (Source: @redlinkleb/53063)

The IDF announced it struck and killed more than 10 terror operatives in the Gaza Strip over the past week, including participants in the October 7 onslaught, and destroyed a Hamas weapons production site belonging to the group's weapons headquarters. (Source: @manniefabian/59516)

Named operatives killed include Muhammad Atta Zaki Qishawi, a Hamas Nukhba Force member who invaded Israel on October 7; Ali Naim Ayesh Abu Osai of the Saif al-Islam faction involved in weapons manufacturing; and Hani Ibrahim Said Khudari, a supply platoon commander. (Source: @manniefabian/59516)

Israeli Paratroopers Brigade soldiers conducted an overnight raid in the Jenin area of the West Bank, detaining four wanted Palestinian terror suspects based on Shin Bet intelligence, two of whom are affiliated with the Islamic State jihadist movement. (Source: @manniefabian/59515)

Palestinian media reported Israeli airstrikes in the Zeitoun neighborhood of Gaza City, resulting in two wounded Palestinians, indicating continued Israeli air operations in northern Gaza. (Source: @yediotnews25/137792)

The IDF confirmed killing over 10 terror operatives in Gaza during the past week, including several who participated in the October 7 attacks, and destroying a Hamas weapons production workshop in a targeted strike. (Source: @manniefabian/59516)

In the West Bank, Israeli forces detained four terror suspects in the Jenin area during an overnight raid by the Paratroopers Brigade acting on Shin Bet intelligence; two detainees are linked to the Islamic State, highlighting IS presence in the area. (Source: @manniefabian/59515)
Israeli warplanes were active over southern Lebanon, with live mapping showing their presence, suggesting ongoing surveillance or strike missions. (Source: @redlinkleb/53063)

Artillery shelling was reported in Wadi al-Salouqi, with additional firefighting or artillery activity noted in the same area, indicating ground-based fire exchanges. (Source: @redlinkleb/53075, @redlinkleb/53040)

Daily statistics for November 13, 2026 show 125 total alerts, 61 drone sightings (most in Kfar Djal, Jibchit, Abba, Qabrikha, Selaa), 3 airstrikes (2 in Kfar Tibnit, 1 in Khiam), and 33 artillery shellings across 17 villages including Mayfadoun (6), Hadatha (5), Wadi al-Salouqi (5), and Zoutar al-Sharqiyah (4). (Source: @redlinkleb/53095)

No explicit reports of military activity in Syria or Iraq were present in the provided messages. Iranian missile launches in western Iran (West Azerbaijan, Khuzestan) may relate to regional posture but no direct Syria/Iraq events were documented. (Source: @shin_persian/12334, @shin_persian/12335, @shin_persian/12339)

Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed responsibility for attacking a US early-warning radar in Bahrain early morning, stating it was retaliation for an airstrike against a communications tower in the city of Sirik, Iran. (Source: @yediotnews25/137782)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's mass funerals for 350 unidentified casualties suggest significant unreported combat losses, possibly from Israeli strikes or internal instability, while its claimed attack on a US radar in Bahrain marks a direct escalation against American assets in the Gulf. Simultaneous missile launches and UAV activity across western and southwestern Iran indicate heightened military readiness or ongoing operations. The IDF's sustained lethal operations in Gaza and West Bank, including targeting senior Hamas operatives and IS-linked cells, demonstrate continued high-tempo counterterrorism pressure. Lebanon's daily alert volume and artillery exchanges reflect persistent cross-border tension. The IAEA's warning on Iran's hidden enrichment facility adds a nuclear dimension to regional volatility.
sections.regional_response: Iran's public funeral ceremonies and leadership attendance serve domestic signaling of resolve despite losses, while its Bahrain strike claim aims to project deterrence against US-Israeli coordination. Israel maintains multi-front pressure: degrading Hamas military infrastructure in Gaza, disrupting West Bank terror networks, and sustaining aerial and artillery presence in southern Lebanon. Gulf states, particularly Bahrain, face direct Iranian missile threats, likely prompting enhanced US-GCC air defense cooperation. The IAEA's alarm over Isfahan may drive renewed diplomatic pressure on Iran's nuclear program, though no immediate joint statement was noted in the data.
sections.intelligence_notes: The concentration of Iranian missile and UAV activity in West Azerbaijan, Khuzestan, and Isfahan provinces suggests a dispersed force posture, possibly protecting strategic depth or preparing for retaliation. The IRGC's specific claim of a US radar strike in Bahrain — if verified — would represent a rare direct kinetic action against US assets, altering escalation calculus. Israel's naming of killed operatives indicates precise intelligence penetration of Hamas and allied factions. The detention of IS-affiliated suspects in Jenin highlights the persistent but underreported Islamic State foothold in the northern West Bank. Lebanon's granular daily statistics reflect robust monitoring by local actors, providing a reliable baseline for cross-border fire trends.
